result:
Summary: On the HotpotQA benchmark, BM25 retrieval achieves an F1 of 0.6166 for sentence-level retrieval and retrieves all supporting facts in only 55.17% of cases. For paragraph-level retrieval, BM25 raises all-supporting-fact recovery to approximately 87–88%, with F1 near 0.67. In the BGE run, dense paragraph retrieval reaches an F1 of 0.7104 and supporting-fact recall of 0.9804 on 3+ supporting-fact questions. BM25's accuracy decreases from 53.7% to 25.9% on the 'easy' and 'hard' subsets of the HOTPOTQA training dataset.
